profile.name: Ganesh Utla
profile.title: Product Engineer - I
profile.bio: Backend-focused Product Engineer with experience building and optimizing scalable fintech systems. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, database optimization, distributed workflows, and end-to-end ownership of production services in high-traffic environments. Currently, exploring System Design and LLM-powered applications.

projects.title: UniMoney
description: Developed a cross-platform mobile application focused on automated personal finance management as part of the B-Tech Final Year Project.
Ranked 1st among 70+ teams in the Mind's Eye Competition for innovation and overall product execution.

Implemented the front-end of the entire application using React Native. Features include automated transaction details extraction from SMS text, Historical statements & Analytics, Gamification elements, Budgeting, CRUD Operations for Transactions, bank accounts, and bill reminders.

projects.title: Medicall
description: Built a comprehensive web application that connects patients with suitable doctors for diagnostics under Solving for India Hackathon'23 hosted by Google, AMD & GFG and secured a spot in regionals.

Worked on front-end of the application using ReactJS. Features include appointment scheduling, live video consultations, WhatsApp & email integration, disease prediction, chatbot assistance, and e-pharmacy.

projects.title: SumUp
description: Developed a web application that simplifies and streamlines summarizing team meetings in just 4-5 minutes under Mastek's Project Deep Blue Hackathon, securing a spot in the Semifinals.
Application supports various file formats such as text, audio, and video. Developed and integrated a Chrome extension with Google Meet to provide live captioning, cloud storage, and highlighter.

projects.title: Codegamy
description: Implemented front-end of a comprehensive platform for coding & interviews with a focus on peer learning.
Developed various features including peer learning using cohort models based on ratings derived using feedback loops for interview preparation.
Other key features include a code runner using JDoodle API, a live interview with Jitsi, a collaborative code editor using SocketIO, learning modules, and user dashboard & analytics.
Designed, developed, and deployed a production-grade e-commerce platform managing a catalog of 6,500+ products, along with a custom-built Admin Panel.
Implemented backend APIs, inventory management, and order processing with real-time analytics, achieving low-millisecond response times for read-heavy endpoints.
Contributed to the Loan Marketplace platform, building backend services and REST APIs that enable seamless interaction between merchants and multiple lenders through standardized workflows.
Played a key role in developing the Credit Line Management system and Lender Gateway integrations, contributing to a revenue growth of nearly 35%.
Improved system performance and reliability by optimizing PostgreSQL queries, indexes, and KV store access patterns, reducing database load by approximately 20%.
Owned and maintained a core backend service responsible for tracking loan lifecycle events, settlements, and end-to-end process states, ensuring data consistency and operational visibility.
Built LLM-based automation for lender integration workflows, enabling automated flow documentation, code generation, and compilation.
Implemented log statements at strategic points in the ARCON's PAM solution and created detailed flowcharts for some PAM programs.
Used the log4net library for debugging the C# code and the Miro software tool for designing flowcharts.
